All modules

day

pages · 0.5.0 · aj-p-day

A past day: its record as it was written (entries, the product's notes and questions), its mood, which stays changeable, on a page reached from Timeline. Composed as Today's sheet is, with no composer. One render for every platform; desktop puts the masthead in the title block beside the page.

variantplatformmobile · tablet · desktop (default mobile)
variantstatedefault · fetch-failed · last-deleted · loading · without-note (default default)
variantcontextscreen · walkthrough (default screen)
contentdatadata
statedefaultyes: the past day as written
statehovern/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statefocus-visiblen/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateactiven/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statedisabledn/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateselectedn/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateloadingyes: day-loading, the day's skeleton in the real sheet, the rows in the record's order (open notes as drawn, their words bones), then the mood row; "Loading this day." announced
stateerroryes: fetch-failed shows a notice and a retry in the sheet
stateemptyn/a: a day with no record arrives with the state packs
